envelope.description: Add the port types, capability check and strict target resolver

body.title: Add the port types, capability check and strict target resolver
body.summary: Create src/workflow/tracker/port.ts with the sc1 types (TrackerPort, PortResult, Capability, IssueSpec, minimal SignoffRequestSpec and SignoffRequestRef, CreatedIssue) and the issueOps field with its IssueOps interface exactly as approved amendment AMD-8 names it, plus missingCapabilities, and add the strict target resolver used only by loadTracker, following the resolveGithubConfig precedence and leaving the lenient resolver untouched.
acceptanceChecks: The exported TrackerPort has a readonly issueOps: IssueOps field and IssueOps has create, linkSubIssue(parent, childId: number), close, comment, readBody, writeBody, ensureLabel, ensureMilestone and attachMilestone with the signatures in AMD-8
missingCapabilities names every capability the tracker does not declare
The strict resolver refuses malformed JSON, a non-object file or entry, an unsupported type, a bad owner or repo and type none
The strict resolver accepts an own entry without a type, falls back to the origin remote for type github, and never takes a target from the default entry
resolveGithubConfig and loadGithubConfigFile are unchanged and no lenient caller (tracker-auto, the bugfix deps, questions.ts) imports the strict resolver
